name: Zone T3+ Break · Asia + NY AM
rules: 15 min. MMM PRO x box engine (G1 expander): an LDx2+ / SDx2+ = a break that makes T3 or higher.
Enter at the CLOSE of the break candle. Long and short.
Stop: 1.5 × ATR. Exit at the opposite break (X5 OPP) or target 1:6.
Only signals in Asia (18:00–02:00 NY) or NY AM (09:30–13:30 NY).
note: The same signal as X.M4, as a full trade. ½ out also works: half off at +0.5R, stop to entry → WR 67% → 69%, avg RR +0.10 → +0.15, t-score 3.6 / 3.3 (EDGE PRO mirror).

name: Contraction T3+ Limit
rules: 15 min. MMM PRO x contraction box: a T3+ break (LDx2+ / SDx2+).
Limit at 75% of the break candle (MP bull / MD bear), 1 tick through.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target 1:2.
Only signals in Asia or NY AM.
note: Limit entry. Trade it full: ½ out had no edge in 2026. 2026 = only the months with 1-min / 5-min data (limit fills need fine bars).

name: 5m iBlock T4+ Long · Top Limit
rules: 5 min. MMM PRO x iBlock of a T4 or higher PO4 (the 3rd continuation or later), bullish.
Buy limit at the TOP of the block (XP) the moment the block is born. No reaction needed.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target 1:2 (steady) or 1:7 (max profit). Exit after 60 candles.
Long only: the same setup short lost in every year.
note: Only the long side works, so it rides the bull trend. 2026 has only Jul–Oct on 5 min.

name: T3+ Break
rules: 15 min. X.M4: an LDx2+ / SDx2+ of the box engine (expander, G1) = a break that makes T3 or higher.
Enter at the CLOSE of the break candle. Long and short.
Stop: 1.5 × ATR. Take ½ off at +0.5R, the runner goes to the opposite break or 1:6.
Yesterday’s daily candle must agree with the trade. No new trades 00:00–02:00 NY.
note: The strongest EDGE PRO setup.

name: Contraction Limit Long
rules: 15 min. After a bullish LDx of a contraction box.
Buy limit at 75% of the break candle (MP), 1 tick through. Only fills in Asia.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Take ½ off at +0.5R, runner to 1:2.
Daily candle green.
note: Limit entry: the first small dip after the break. 2026 = only the months with 1-min / 5-min data (limit fills need fine bars): +0.06 avg RR there.

name: GMC c3 AFs Against
rules: 15 min. MMM PRO c GMC where candle 3 is an AFs against the gap (sweeps and closes back inside).
Enter at the close of candle 3. Long and short.
Stop: 1 × ATR. Exit X1 (opposite body close confirmed) or target 1:6.
Only signals in Asia or NY AM.
note: A GMC that survives a fake rejection. Trade it full: ½ out killed the edge (avg RR +0.01 → +0.05 at 0.5R).

name: GMC Long · Fixed 50
rules: 15 min. Every bullish GMC of MMM PRO c.
Enter at the close of candle 3. Long only.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target 1:2. Exit early on a confirmed close below the gap-candle open (X3-O).
Only signals in Asia or NY AM.
note: Small edge per trade, many trades. ½ out also works: half off at 1R, stop to entry → WR 48% → 51%, avg RR +0.04 → +0.09, t-score 3.4 / 3.1 (EDGE PRO mirror).

name: GMC Long
rules: 15 min. Every bullish GMC (c2 closes above c1 high, c3 low stays above c1 high).
Enter at the close of candle 3. Long only.
Stop: 1 × ATR. Take ½ off at +0.75R, runner to 1:3.
Daily candle green. No new trades 00:00–02:00 NY.
note: The busiest EDGE PRO setup.

name: GMC AFs Long
rules: 15 min. A bullish GMC where candle 3 makes a new high and closes back inside candle 2 (AFs against).
Enter at the close of candle 3. Long only.
Stop: fixed 50 pts (NQ / MNQ). Full position, target 1:6.
Out at the next session open (02:00 · 08:00 · 09:30 NY) if the stop or the target did not hit first.
Daily candle green and the 1h box trend up. No new trades 00:00–02:00 NY.
note: A fake rejection inside an urgent gap. New rule (Oct 30 2026): fixed 50 pt stop, full position to 1:6, out at the next session open. ES and gold keep the old ATR + ½ out rule.
tgt: 1:6 RR full · out at the next session open

name: BC+ Long
rules: 15 min. A BC+ bull candle: close above the previous high, no lower low, close in the upper half.
Enter at the close. Long only.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Take ½ off at +0.5R, runner to 1:2.
Daily candle green and the 1h trend up. No new trades 00:00–02:00 NY.
note: Smallest edge per trade.

name: Level Retest A · Max Profit
rules: 1 min. NY AM only: the CDL candle opens 09:30–11:59 New York. Long only.
Levels: daily open, PDH / PDL, overnight high / low, Asia high / low, 09:30 open, prior 16:00 close, H1 / H4 GMC.
The 1m MMM Pro structure flips up (CDL) and the new PO4 T1 is within 15 pts of a level. The 15m MMM trend is up. No GMC gap between the PO4 T1 and the CDL.
At the CDL close, place a buy limit at the PO4 T1 (fills 1 tick through). Cancel at 1:2 untouched or after 60 candles. A candle closing back below the T1 does NOT cancel it.
Stop: 40 pts. Target 1:5 (200 pts). Stop or target only. Out at the 16:59 close if neither. One trade at a time.
note: Max’s own method, tested with honest fills (Oct 24 2026 correction). 2026 = only the months with real 1-min data, so period 2 is small: paper-trade first.

name: Level Retest B · Small Loss
rules: 1 min. NY AM only: the CDL candle opens 09:30–11:59 New York. Long only.
Levels: daily open, PDH / PDL, overnight high / low, Asia high / low, 09:30 open, prior 16:00 close, H1 / H4 GMC.
The 1m MMM Pro structure flips up (CDL) and the new PO4 T1 is within 15 pts of a level. The 15m MMM trend is up. No GMC gap between the PO4 T1 and the CDL.
At the CDL close, place a buy limit at the PO4 T1 (fills 1 tick through). Cancel at 1:2 untouched or after 60 candles. A candle closing back below the T1 does NOT cancel it.
Stop: 35 pts. Target 1:5 (175 pts). Max’s 2-candle exit: after a 1m close below the T1 (candle V), get out when a later candle closes below V’s low. A close back above the T1 resets it. Out at 16:59.
note: Smaller losses, lower WR, longer losing runs than A. 2026 = only the months with real 1-min data: paper-trade first.

name: 09:30 BuBC above the pre-open high
rules: 15 min. The 09:30–09:45 New York candle is a BuBC (it closes above the previous candle’s high).
It also closes ABOVE the pre-open high (the highest price from 08:00 to 09:30).
Buy at its close (09:45). One trade a day.
Stop: 50 pts. Target 1:3 (150 pts). Get out early at the first 15m close below the candle’s low. Out at the 16:59 close if nothing hits.
note: The pre-open filter was picked from 14 filters, so expect it to be a little weaker live. Without the filter it still passes (avg RR +0.26, t-score 2.97).
tgt: 1:3 RR or a close below the 09:30 low

name: Late Continuation Break (P5+)
rules: 15 min. Engines x, c and s (any of them).
Wait for the 5th continuation break or later in the same trend: a candle CLOSES past P5, P6 … (LD5+ / SD5+). Its new PO4 is T6 or higher.
Enter at the CLOSE of the break candle (market). Long and short.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target: 1:2 (steady) or 1:7 (max profit).
Exit at market after 60 candles (15 hours) if neither stop nor target is hit.
note: Positive in every year 2023–2026. About 1 trade a day.

name: Any Continuation Break (P1+)
rules: 15 min. Engines x, c and s.
A candle CLOSES past any P# of the current trend (LD / SD, first one or later).
Enter at the CLOSE of the break candle. Long and short.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target 1:1 or 1:2 only (bigger targets died in 2026).
Exit after 60 candles if nothing is hit.
note: Many trades, positive every year, very small edge per trade. Trades often overlap.

name: H4 GMC AFs → 15m CDL Pullback BC
rules: Filter on 4 hours: price touches a bull GMC (gap edge = c1 high) and, on that candle or within 3 candles, prints a bullish AFs. No 4H close below the GMC open. Mirror for shorts.
The filter lives 6 four-hour candles. It dies if a 4H candle closes below the AFs low.
Drop to 15 min: a CDL of engine x, c or s (already there or new), then a bearish BC (the pullback).
Enter at the CLOSE of the next 15m BuBC (the first bull body close after the pullback).
Only 15m entries in Asia (18:00–02:00 NY) or NY AM (09:30–13:30 NY). Stop: 50 pts fixed. Exit after 60 four-hour candles.
Long and short.
note: Plus in both periods but a small sample (about 60 trades a year). The short side is weak.

name: H4 GMC AFs → 15m CDL Pullback BC · Long
rules: Filter on 4 hours: price touches a bull GMC (gap edge = c1 high) and, on that candle or within 3 candles, prints a bullish AFs. No 4H close below the GMC open. Mirror for shorts.
The filter lives 6 four-hour candles. It dies if a 4H candle closes below the AFs low.
Drop to 15 min: a CDL of engine x, c or s (already there or new), then a bearish BC (the pullback).
Enter at the CLOSE of the next 15m BuBC (the first bull body close after the pullback).
Only 15m entries in Asia (18:00–02:00 NY) or NY AM (09:30–13:30 NY). Stop: 50 pts fixed. Exit after 60 four-hour candles.
Longs only.
note: The strongest numbers, but only 137 + 28 trades and both periods were bull markets.

name: 15m iBlock Pre-Market AFs+
rules: 15 min. An iBlock of engine x, c or s: the origin box of a T2 or higher PO4 (a continuation, not the flip).
Price touches the iBlock for the first time, on a 15m candle that opens between 08:00 and 09:15 NY (pre-market).
Within 10 candles, an AFs+ in the block direction prints (sweeps the previous candle, closes back inside it, close in the good half), with no close through the PO4 line first.
Enter at the CLOSE of the AFs+ candle. Stop: 1 tick past the AFs+ candle low (long) / high (short).
Target 1:2 (steady) or 1:3. Exit after 60 candles (15 hours). Long and short.
note: Found by the block profile scan: the only block pattern that held in every year. Small sample (about 4 trades a month) and found by searching, so paper-trade it first.

name: 1m NY AM Long · 2 Green MMPD Candles
rules: 1 min. MMPD auto length: 27 on 1m and 2m, 14 on 15m, 1h and 4h. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background (body top at 20 or below). ▼ = the mirror at 80. The arrow lives until the MMPD goes back into that background or the opposite arrow prints.

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC. The first setup must come within 30 candles of the arrow. After a setup, a new bearish BC re-arms it for the next one. Shorts = the mirror. Every setup while the arrow lives counts.
Confirm: wait up to 10 candles for 2 green MMPD candles in a row (MMPD close above its open, twice). Price must keep closing above that bearish BC open.
Skip the trade if the red background before the arrow was PURE (every price candle inside it was red).
Enter at the close of the confirm candle. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York only. Long only.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target: 1:1 (+50 pts). Close anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time.
note: The busiest MMPD strategy: about 38 trades a month. Made money in every year 2023–2026. Other version that also works: the last 5m candle closed green instead of the 2 green MMPD candles.

name: 2m NY AM Long · First Setup · Lock 1R + STRONG2
rules: 2 min. MMPD auto length: 27 on 1m and 2m, 14 on 15m, 1h and 4h. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background (body top at 20 or below). ▼ = the mirror at 80. The arrow lives until the MMPD goes back into that background or the opposite arrow prints.

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC. The first setup must come within 30 candles of the arrow. After a setup, a new bearish BC re-arms it for the next one. Shorts = the mirror. Only the FIRST setup of each arrow.
Enter at the close of the setup BC. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York only. Long only.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. When price reaches +100 pts (2R), move the stop to entry +51 pts (1R + fees), then use the STRONG2 trail. No fixed target.
STRONG2 trail: from the 2nd bullish BC after entry, at each new bullish BC move the stop to the low of the bigger-body BC of the last two. The stop only moves up.
Block exit: note the XD block (MMM PRO c) alive under price at entry. If a candle closes below that block’s bottom, get out at the close.
Close anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time.
note: The most money per trade on the day-trade MMPD strategies (average win about 1.9R). Long losing runs: up to 14 in a row.

name: 15m NY AM Long · 1 Green MMPD Candle · STRONG2
rules: 15 min. MMPD auto length: 27 on 1m and 2m, 14 on 15m, 1h and 4h. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background (body top at 20 or below). ▼ = the mirror at 80. The arrow lives until the MMPD goes back into that background or the opposite arrow prints.

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC. The first setup must come within 30 candles of the arrow. After a setup, a new bearish BC re-arms it for the next one. Shorts = the mirror. Every setup while the arrow lives counts.
Confirm: wait up to 10 candles for 1 green MMPD candle (MMPD close above its open). Price must keep closing above that bearish BC open.
Enter at the close of the confirm candle. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York only. Long only.
Stop: the lowest low of the entry candle and the 2 before it, minus 2 pts (8 ticks). Size the trade so this stop = your risk.
STRONG2 trail: from the 2nd bullish BC after entry, at each new bullish BC move the stop to the low of the bigger-body BC of the last two. The stop only moves up. No fixed target.
Also get out at the close if an opposite (short) setup prints. Close anything still open at 16:00 New York.
note: The smoothest MMPD strategy: the smallest drawdown for the money made. Only about 6 trades a month.
tgt: STRONG2 trail · out on an opposite setup

name: 15m NY AM Long + Short · 1 MMPD Candle · Lock BE
rules: 15 min. MMPD auto length: 27 on 1m and 2m, 14 on 15m, 1h and 4h. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background (body top at 20 or below). ▼ = the mirror at 80. The arrow lives until the MMPD goes back into that background or the opposite arrow prints.

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC. The first setup must come within 30 candles of the arrow. After a setup, a new bearish BC re-arms it for the next one. Shorts = the mirror. Every setup while the arrow lives counts. Long and short.
Confirm: 1 green MMPD candle for longs, 1 red / pink MMPD candle for shorts, within 10 candles.
Enter at the close of the confirm candle. Entries 09:30–11:30 New York only.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. At +50 pts (1R) move the stop to entry + 1 pt (fees), then the STRONG2 trail. No fixed target.
Get out early if a BC against you closes past the arrow candle’s low (long) / high (short). Close anything still open at 16:00 New York.
note: Held past 16:00 it made money every year. Closed at 16:00 (how it is tested here), 2023 lost a little: watch it. For day trading use MMPD.M3.
tgt: lock BE at +1R, then STRONG2 trail

name: 1h Long · Swing · STRONG2
rules: 1 hour. MMPD auto length: 27 on 1m and 2m, 14 on 15m, 1h and 4h. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background (body top at 20 or below). ▼ = the mirror at 80. The arrow lives until the MMPD goes back into that background or the opposite arrow prints.

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the OPEN of the last bearish BC. The first setup must come within 30 candles of the arrow. After a setup, a new bearish BC re-arms it for the next one. Shorts = the mirror. Only the first setup of each arrow, any hour.
Enter at the close of the setup BC. Long only.
Stop: the lowest low of the entry candle and the 2 before it, minus 2 pts.
Exit: STRONG2 trail, starting at the first bullish BC after entry that closes in profit (compared with the entry BC). No fixed target.
Holds overnight: about 15 hours on average. Only for accounts that allow overnight holds.
note: A swing strategy: works on every year tested, but needs overnight holds.

name: 4h Short · Swing · MAX EXIT
rules: 4 hours. MMPD auto length: 27 on 1m and 2m, 14 on 15m, 1h and 4h. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background (body top at 20 or below). ▼ = the mirror at 80. The arrow lives until the MMPD goes back into that background or the opposite arrow prints.
Setup: a bearish BC (closes below the previous candle’s low) that closes below the OPEN of the last bullish BC, within 30 candles of the ▼ arrow. Only the first setup of each arrow, any hour.
Enter at the close of the setup BC. Short only.
Stop: 50 pts fixed.
MAX EXIT: get out when the MMPD drops to 50 or below and then closes back at 50 or above, or when the arrow ends.
Holds overnight: about 28 hours on average. Only for accounts that allow overnight holds.
note: Few trades (about 3 a month), big winners (about 6.6R on average): long losing runs are normal.

name: 2m NY AM Long · A · BC Break After the ▲ Arrow
rules: 2 min. MMPD length 27 on 2m. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background. The arrow lives until the MMPD body goes back to 20 or below, or the ▼ arrow prints after it touched 80.
Arrow candle colour: take the ▲ only if the MMPD candle on the arrow is GREEN (above its open, rising) or PINK (below its open, rising). Skip it on PALE GREEN (above its open, falling).

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the HIGH of the last bearish BC. It can come before the arrow (after the lowest candle of the red background) or after it. Enter at the close of the candle where both the arrow and the break are in.
XD box = high to low of the lowest candle while the MMPD body was at 20 or below. If price closes below the XD box low before you enter, the setup is dead.
Entries 09:30–11:30 New York only. Long only. FOMC days skipped.
Stop: 50 pts fixed. Target: 1:2 (+100 pts). No early exit on the box. Close anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time.
note: Max’s general MMPD scalping entry, as tested. Held past 16:00 it made a little more (+5.9 pts a trade, t-score 2.5).

name: 2m NY AM Long · A+ · Wait for an MMPD Open Above 50
rules: 2 min. MMPD length 27 on 2m. ▲ arrow = the MMPD body bottom goes back above 20 after the red background. The arrow lives until the MMPD body goes back to 20 or below, or the ▼ arrow prints after it touched 80.
Arrow candle colour: take the ▲ only if the MMPD candle on the arrow is GREEN (above its open, rising) or PINK (below its open, rising). Skip it on PALE GREEN (above its open, falling).
A+ confirm: after the arrow, wait for an MMPD candle that OPENS above 50. Take the setup on or after that candle, while the arrow still lives.

Setup: a bullish BC (closes above the previous candle’s high) that closes above the HIGH of the last bearish BC. It can come before the arrow (after the lowest candle of the red background) or after it. Enter at the close of the candle where both the arrow and the break are in.
XD box = high to low of the lowest candle while the MMPD body was at 20 or below. If price closes below the XD box low before you enter, the setup is dead.
Entries 09:30–11:30 New York only. Long only. FOMC days skipped.
Stop: 45 pts fixed. Target: 1:2 (+90 pts). No early exit on the box. Close anything still open at 16:00 New York. One trade at a time.
note: The A+ version: fewer trades (about 2 of every 3 kept), more per trade and a smaller drawdown than A. Held past 16:00: +7.1 pts a trade, t-score 2.7.
